checks.label: Duplicate payment verification
checks.detail: No high-confidence duplicates after filtering 2270 batch payments and 42717 CSV overlaps. Previous false positives eliminated.

checks.label: Split payment analysis
checks.detail: 547 suspect instances (£189.5M, 9.1% of spend). Threshold: 5+ payments to same supplier in same week, 80%+ of approval limit.

checks.label: Year-end spike verification
checks.detail: Highest spike: 1.8x in ADULT SOCIAL CARE. Year-end spikes are common in public sector (capital programmes, grants). Only extreme spikes (>3x) warrant concern.

checks.label: CH breach temporal verification
checks.detail: 3 suppliers with £30.6K confirmed during active breach periods. Enrichment errors excluded. Only dated violations with confirmed overlap flagged.

checks.label: Benford's Law forensic screening
checks.detail: Significant deviation from Benford's Law (p < 0.001). χ²=35614.18 on 488499 amounts >£100. Largest deviation: digit 1 (10.4% off expected).
